I’ve visited both sites and prepared feedback:

**Dora’s website (www.dora-website.com)**  
- I’ve already invited Dora to Slack and sent her a direct message with the following feedback:  

> “Hi Dora, I visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com. I think it’s great that you have a personal site showcasing your work. A few suggestions: consider adding a brief introduction about your skills and projects, and maybe include some examples of your work or a portfolio section. Also, ensure the contact email is clearly visible. Keep up the good work!”
